title: Wgpu Shell Half of Tutorial Mechanism
description: Implement the wgpu-shell half of the new "Tutorial" mechanism (sibling of the existing Introduction mechanism), in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, in parity with the concurrently-developed React shell half (ticket REACT-SHELL-HALF-OF-TUTORIAL-MECHANISM). Rust core data model is complete in framework/core/rs/lib.rs region 🔖️Tutorial (TutorialDefinition, TutorialRuntime state machine inputs, tutorial_slice/compose_tutorial_ui/interpolate_tutorial_camera/tutorial_camera_at/apply_tutorial_ui_change engine fns). This ticket covers: ShellState.tutorial: Option<TutorialRuntime> field, tutorial control bar rendering (render_tutorial_bar reusing navbar widget helpers), per-frame tutorial tick (advance playhead, apply UI/document/camera tracks), seek, deviation detection (pause on real user action during playback), a minimal recorder tapping the action-dispatch funnel, ghost-cursor gesture painter, START_TUTORIAL_ACTION_ID/RECORD_TUTORIAL_ACTION_ID interception mirroring START_INTRODUCTION_ACTION_ID, and a navbar trigger button. Document mutation during playback comes solely from tracks.document; TutorialEvents are annotational-only. Camera is the only interpolated track (TUTORIAL_CONVERGE_MS=600ms tween on deviation-resume). Playback is sandboxed (snapshot/restore live document). Media (webcam/mic) recording explicitly out of scope. Only Rust files touched, no .tsx/.ts.
summary:
Implemented the full wgpu-shell half of the Tutorial mechanism in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, region `//#region 🎬️Tutorial` (placed right after `//#endregion 🔖️ChromeOverlaysAndTour`, before `render_chrome`). Added `ShellState.tutorial: Option<TutorialRuntime>` (mode Playing/Paused/Recording/Deviated, playhead/rate, sandbox snapshot, per-window camera convergence map, recorder bookkeeping) plus `tutorial_pending_document_ops` (a deferred queue since chrome rendering is sync but the plugin bridge's document/action calls are async — mirrors how `scene_events` already gets deferred via `spawn_app_task`).

Implemented: tutorial_start/tutorial_stop (sandboxed load/restore via the existing `load_app_document`/`apply_operations` plugin-bridge mechanism), tutorial_start_recording (arms against the LIVE document, never sandboxed), tutorial_toggle_play_pause (including the Deviated→Playing converge-then-resume flow), tutorial_seek (compose_tutorial_ui wholesale + tutorial_slice for document ops + tutorial_camera_at exactly), tutorial_tick (per-frame playhead advance/recorder sampling/camera resolution, called from `AppRuntime::frame` before `render_chrome`), tutorial_note_real_dispatch (deviation detection + annotational event recording, hooked at the very top of `dispatch_action`), and tutorial_flush_pending_document_ops (async, drains the pending-ops queue via `apply_operations`/`load_app_document`/replayed `dispatch_action` history actions, guarded by a `TutorialDispatchGuard` thread-local so its own replay never re-triggers deviation/recording).

Chrome: `render_tutorial_bar` (play/pause, stop, scrubber, time, rate selector — reuses `ChromeGroupItem`/`render_chrome_group`/`chrome_clicked_this_frame`), called right after `render_navbar`; `body_rect` now reserves `tutorial_bar_height` (reuses `theme.navbar_height`) while a tutorial is active; a "Play Tutorial" navbar trigger button beside the introduction-tour trigger (mutual exclusion wired both directions); a minimal ghost-cursor gesture overlay (`render_tutorial_gesture_overlay`, ring painted via `push_rounded`) resolving `IntroductionPoint::{Screen,ScreenNormalized,Element,Window,WindowNormalized}` through the existing `resolve_element_rect`/`window_content_rects` registries. Camera conversion (`orbit_to_tutorial_camera`/`tutorial_camera_to_orbit`) needed a new direct Cargo dependency on `kernel_3d_scene` (added to framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/Cargo.toml) since `infinite_world` imports `OrbitController`/`Camera3d` privately.

Scoped out (documented inline): `example_id`-only sandbox base (no example-switch primitive reachable without duplicating `apply_shell_uri`); `Scene`/`Canvas`/`Entity`/`Curve`/`Domain` gesture point kinds (no per-window world→screen resolver exists as reusable infra); `expanded_tree_ids` UI-snapshot field (no generic tree-expansion state on ShellState, only per-accordion `collapsed_sections` with different semantics); webcam/mic recording (explicitly out of scope per the ticket).

Verification: `cargo build -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu` succeeds (zero errors, zero tutorial-related warnings — pre-existing warnings/dead-code lints elsewhere untouched). `cargo test -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu --lib` — 281 passed, 0 failed (15 new tests in `shell::tutorial_tests`, covering playhead-advance math, scrub progress/hit-mapping, orbit↔TutorialCameraState round-trip, UI-snapshot round-trip and panel-tab-absence-closes-panel, live UI-change application, gesture-point resolution incl. scoped-out kinds, seek clamping, deviation detection, and recorder event filtering). Had to add the already-core-added `tutorials: Vec::new()` field to two pre-existing `AppDefinition` test-fixture literals in this same file (unrelated to Tutorial itself, just blocking compilation of this crate's existing tests after core's AppDefinition gained that field).

Files touched: framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock (auto-updated, +1 line for the new kernel_3d_scene dependency edge). No .ts/.tsx files touched.
